calendar.dailyRouteSeeds: shared across accounts by calendar date

source.limitation: Gross template creation before salvage/equipment use; shared calendar, first30 days only. No behavior, bot profile, server authority or mature-year observation.

assumptions.source: Pinned C2 gross creation, before use/salvage; mean extrapolation after30 observed days. Actual ordinary authority stays zero.
assumptions.behavior: Same persistent participation at every fee;50% finite style/forge interest. These are structural sensitivities, NOT estimated demand elasticity. Both spending orders retained.
assumptions.economics: Grant20, sale5%, forge3, style4 and allocation unchanged. Boss1.5 for13 weeks, closed rank settled under actual cap; no renewed routine entitlement.
assumptions.metric: All claims including grants; original2x flow and3x farmer gates, separate seasonal1x target. Actual recipes and the ORIGINAL interested cohort retained, not only successful buyers.
assumptions.basket: 5% is the exact upper seal rate fitting2 Epic seals+3 forge+4 style+one Star Thread seal+2 reserve in20. Fee reduction cannot burn money retained by absent recipients.
assumptions.scope: No signed seal policy, production fee, contract, source authority, combat stat, grant or deployment is changed.
